item.title: [HIGH] Skatteetaten uncovers AI-generated fake receipts behind 2bn NOK in bogus tax claims
item.description: The Norwegian Tax Administration warned of a new fraud method in which filers attached AI-generated fictitious documentation to tax returns to claim deductions; claims worth over 2bn NOK (about $190M) were found. Target: Norwegian Tax Administration. NO. Verification: reported.
